alternatives_rejected.why: It does not appear among the significant deviations across all services (E1). recommendationservice's own span self-time, which excludes downstream calls, rose 2.53x (E2), so the slowness is inside recommendationservice.

frontend latency-50 shifted only z=15.9, far below recommendationservice latency-90 at z=162.5 and CPU at z=54.7 (E1). Caller-observed latency into recommendationservice rose 6.49x (E2), so frontend is a symptom.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the CPU-hogging workload in the recommendationservice pod. Meanwhile, scale out recommendationservice replicas or raise its CPU limit to restore latency, then confirm that p50/p90 latency and CPU return to baseline.
